points.point: Can brand kit be tied to its own accounts
points.sentence: The Blotato website does not support account groups or automatic links between social accounts and Brand Kits.
When you use Claude, ChatGPT, or another AI agent through Blotato MCP, create a brand-to-account mapping with each brand name, platform, account name, and account ID.

verdict.reason: The entry states that Brand Kits can't be linked to accounts automatically and gives the MCP mapping workaround for Claude, which answers both points.
